a7a0bd01f0.q: How has customer experience evolved from traditional customer service roles to the modern discipline at Rotork?
a7a0bd01f0.a: Traditionally, organizations had a head of customer service focused on managing inbound contact via telephone, email, and fax. Over the last 10 years, the discipline of customer experience has emerged, recognizing that customer interactions extend well beyond service channels to include websites, products, marketing materials, and all touchpoints. This led to the role of customer experience leader to define strategy, make customers feel the right way across their journey, use appropriate KPIs, and conduct voice of the customer research to validate the experience.

1a29733c93.q: What is Rotork's approach to using technology and automation in customer experience delivery?
1a29733c93.a: Ryan Davies believes in giving technology tools to frontline staff as an augmented experience where technology complements rather than replaces people. At Rotork, they may use automation to process documents and understand key points, but personalization comes from the detailed engineering knowledge of frontline teams. The goal is to speed up processes so frontline staff can personalize solutions for customers, adding value in all the right places.

483a584f78.q: How does B2B customer experience differ from B2C in an industrial engineering context like Rotork?
483a584f78.a: In B2B, products are bespoke to individual customers with very clear purposes, and experience heavily depends on the technical knowledge and expertise of people working with the customer. B2B becomes much more relationship-building and understanding, underpinned by core competencies, rather than transactional. Unlike a simple retail transaction, B2B develops relationships over longer periods where customers are more likely to recommend based on how easy the organization makes it to do business.

8bffcfbdad.q: What voice of customer research program has Rotork implemented with B2B International?
8bffcfbdad.a: Rotork has been working with B2B International for just over a year to embed a strong voice of the customer program. The program operates in two main ways: transactional experience measurement at key touchpoints along the customer journey (like quotation ease), and relational experience measurement for longstanding customers running projects over years, assessing how they feel about Rotork across categories like account management and pricing.

1fa99a23d1.q: How does Rotork prioritize improvements from CX research findings to maximize customer satisfaction impact?
1fa99a23d1.a: Rotork works with B2B International quarterly to create narratives from customer research and present them to the management board. They use tools to show that improving specific areas would have measurable impact on overall customer satisfaction, demonstrating how different improvements have bigger or lesser impacts. This helps avoid low-priority changes and focus on quick wins and longer-term strategic improvements rather than attempting everything at once.
